summary: Frontend-only retest for logout redirect bug on Contractor OS. Verified the auth guard fix in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx. Full flow validated: login with jane@acme.com.au/pass123 -> Dashboard renders with all 4 tabs (Dashboard/CRM/Quotes/Jobs) -> tap logout-button -> app navigates to /login and email-input/password-input/auth-submit-button are visible -> re-login succeeds and returns to Dashboard. No regressions observed. Two harmless deprecation warnings from RN-web ('shadow*' style props, 'props.pointerEvents') were logged in console but do not affect functionality; noted for future cleanup.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: styles using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius in frontend theme/components.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely originates from a third-party or component setting pointerEvents as a prop.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' for react-native-web compatibility.
Optional cleanup: replace prop-based 'pointerEvents' with style.pointerEvents where applicable.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth guard implementation is correct and idiomatic: `if (!loading && !user) return <Redirect href='/login' />` in (tabs)/_layout.tsx. Prevents rendering the tabs shell before redirect, which fixes the previously-observed 'Hi,' blank header after logout.
AuthContext.logout() correctly clears token + state, triggering the guard to redirect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logout redirect bug fully verified fixed on iteration_7. Login/Logout/Re-login round-trip works. Deprecation warnings only. Test credentials: jane@acme.com.au / pass123.
rca_of_issue: Previous bug: logout() cleared user state but the (tabs) layout continued to render, showing an empty 'Hi,' header. RCA: no auth guard on the (tabs) group route. Fix: added `if (!loading && !user) return <Redirect href='/login' />` at the top of TabsLayout, causing an immediate route swap to /login when the user becomes null. Reproduction (now fails to reproduce = fixed): login -> Dashboard -> tap logout-button -> observe navigation to /login.
